answer: Shared-Resource Accounting Ledger. Each identity must submit a unique work receipt drawn from a scarce physical resource pool; duplicate receipts collide on the same ledger slot, exposing the copy. Any gale of new signups forces each to consume a distinct metered unit, so mass duplication drains the pool. The attacker pays one real resource unit per fake identity, and a single reuse traces a pearl of evidence back through the thread tying identities to one receipt.
